newsitem.title: USA: D&P rates O'Higgins Central Hispanoamericano.
newsitem.headline: D&P rates O'Higgins Central Hispanoamericano.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it assigned a long-term foreign currency rating of single-A-minus to O'Higgins Central Hispanoamericano SA and a long-term local currency rating of single-A.

O'Higgins Central is a holding company with extensive interests in the financial services sector in the southern cone of Latin America. It is controlled by the Luksic Group, one of Chile's largest conglomerates, and Banco Central Hispanoamericano SA, a large Spanish bank.
D&P said the ratings reflect the strength of Banco Santiago, its main asset, and the strength and commitment of its principal shareholders.
The ratings are constrained, however, by the holding company's subordinated position relative to its operating subsidiaries and the higher risk profile of its other bank subsidiaries, D&P added.
D&P said it assigned Banco Santiago a long-term foreign currency rating of single-A-minus and a long-term local currency rating of double-A-minus.
It also assigned a short-term foreign currency rating of "D-2" and a short-term local currency rating of "D-One-Plus".
